# Compatibility

<!-- Generated by scripts/render-compat.mjs from compat/matrix.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Results of the end-to-end compatibility check (`test/e2e/compat.spec.ts`) against real Bricks
builder installs. Each capability is exercised in the builder; undoable actions also verify one
history entry, undo and redo. "–" means not tested on that version.

| Capability | Bricks 2.4.3 |
| --- | :---: |
| `selection.get` | pass |
| `selection.set` | pass |
| `selection.onChange` | pass |
| `selection.navigate` | pass |
| `elements.get` | pass |
| `elements.insert` | pass |
| `elements.duplicate` | pass |
| `elements.delete` | pass |
| `elements.wrap` | pass |
| `elements.rename` | pass |
| `clipboard.copy` | pass |
| `clipboard.paste` | pass |
| `history.undo` | pass |
| `history.redo` | pass |
| `document.save` | pass |
| `document.unsavedChanges` | pass |
| `ui.isTyping` | pass |
| `ui.commandPalette` | pass |
| `ui.showPanel` | pass |
| `ui.breakpoints` | pass |
| `ui.toggleClasses` | pass |
| `ui.rename` | pass |

To add a version: run `npm run test:e2e` against a site with that Bricks version
(`BRICKS_URL=...`), then `npm run compat`.
